summary: Training Booth backend + frontend tested. Backend: 17/17 pytest pass (7 new test_booth + 10 regression). Frontend: booth-menu with 5 level cards (levels 3-5 locked for player unlocked_level=2), 18 caliber-* buttons across 5 categories, caliber persistence in localStorage 'hog_island_booth_caliber', level selection updates ledger + start-button label, HUD shows all required data-testids on booth-screen. Pointer lock actually worked in headless: rangefinder/solution/range/mildot-reticle all functioned; RMB toggled mildot-reticle; LMB fired and decremented ammo; R triggered hud-reloading and refilled mag. Zero controls: keyboard (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/[/]/scroll) work correctly (bounded at 25 yd min and 1000 yd max) both while overlay is visible and while locked. Two frontend issues found (see below). No console errors seen.

ui_bugs.issue: zero-up-button and zero-down-button are never clickable via mouse. While the booth-overlay is showing, the fullscreen overlay div (pointer-events-auto backdrop-blur) intercepts the click; once pointer is locked and the overlay unmounts, the three.js <canvas> element (the overlay's sibling) intercepts pointer events on the same coordinates because the canvas fills the viewport and sits on top in z-order (Playwright reports: '<canvas ... data-engine=three.js r169> intercepts pointer events'). Keyboard (ArrowUp/ArrowDown/[/]/scroll) works, but the on-screen chevron buttons are dead UI. Fix: give the BoothHUD zero card a higher z-index (e.g. z-20 relative pointer-events-auto wrapper) and/or ensure the canvas is pointer-events-none while locked so HUD buttons receive clicks.

After the user presses Escape to release pointer lock during gameplay, the booth-overlay does not reappear (booth-overlay count stays 0). booth-exit-button and audio-settings live only inside that overlay, so the player is stranded in the range with no way to reach 'Leave the booth' short of finishing 20 targets. Root cause: BoothHUD conditions overlay on `!locked && phase !== 'done'`. `setLocked` is driven by the pointerlockchange listener which does fire, so `locked` should flip to false and the overlay should re-mount — this worked at start but not after Escape in headless Chromium. Likely because state has drifted (phase became 'running' but a subsequent re-render is being blocked or requestLock is being re-called from a stray click). Suggest: add a keydown listener for 'Escape' that explicitly forces `setLocked(false)` and unlocks controlsRef.current, and gate PointerLockControls' domElement to the canvas so background clicks don't auto-relock.

action_items: Give BoothHUD zero-card (zero-up/zero-down) a higher stacking context (z-index / pointer-events-auto wrapper) or make the three.js canvas pointer-events-none while locked so the on-screen chevrons are actually clickable.

Ensure the booth-overlay re-mounts when the pointer lock is exited via Escape. Either listen for keydown Escape in BoothScreen and setLocked(false)+unlock explicitly, or scope PointerLockControls' click-to-lock domElement to the canvas so a stray body click can't re-lock immediately.
critical_code_review_comments: BoothScreen.jsx (~500 lines) mixes player controller, ballistics, wind/target lifecycle, HUD wiring, and input handlers — split into hooks (usePointerController, useTargetLoop, useZeroControls).

server.py booth_submit rank query counts booth_results with strictly greater score across the whole level — this ranks the just-submitted score against every historical row including duplicates from the same player. For a per-player leaderboard-style rank, use the aggregated best-per-player pipeline like /booth/leaderboard uses, then find the player's position. Otherwise a player can appear ranked lower than they show up on GET /booth/leaderboard.

booth_progress bests is stored as a dict keyed by string level. Consider adding a Pydantic validator / index (player_id) to guarantee unique progress rows — currently a race on first request could insert twice.

Frontend caliber-picker container itself has data-testid=caliber-picker which matches `[data-testid^=caliber-]`; consider renaming to `caliber-list` to avoid collision with the per-caliber buttons in test selectors.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend booth endpoints fully verified (progress bootstrap, pass→unlock, lower-score no-op, locked 403, level=6 400, hits>shots 400, leaderboard sort/rank/fields). Pointer lock actually works in the headless test runner via booth-start-button → resume-play-button, so gameplay HUD (hud-rangefinder, hud-solution, hud-range, mildot-reticle, hud-ammo-counter) and LMB/RMB/R keys were exercised. Two open bugs: (1) mouse-clickable zero-up/down chevrons blocked (overlay before lock, canvas after lock), (2) booth-overlay does not restore after Escape so booth-exit-button is unreachable during gameplay. 20-target completion flow (booth-results/booth-final-score/booth-retry-button/booth-next-button) was not exercised because targets take 5-15s each and total run time budget is limited; can be tested by scripting mass LMB fire+wait cycles.
rca of the issue: 1) Zero chevrons: BoothHUD zero card is a sibling of the fullscreen overlay div and the <canvas>. Both stack above the chevron container in DOM order or with equal z-index; Playwright confirms canvas intercepts pointer events after lock, overlay intercepts before lock. Add a positioned wrapper with z-30 pointer-events-auto and give <canvas> pointer-events-none once locked. 2) Escape/exit: BoothHUD renders overlay only when !locked && phase !== 'done'. pointerlockchange fires on Escape and setLocked(false) should re-mount overlay. In practice this does not happen in the current build — likely because the drei PointerLockControls click-to-lock handler on document body re-locks immediately on subsequent clicks/hover in headless. Scope PointerLockControls to the canvas via `selector` prop or omit the click-to-lock behaviour and require an explicit resume-play-button press to re-lock.
